name: Freeciv
hint: Freeciv 3.1 server for the turn-based civilization game, joined over IPv6

AI_PLAYERS.title: Total players
AI_PLAYERS.description: AI nations fill the game up to this many players and step aside as people join. Players need a Freeciv 3.1 client (3.2 can't join), connect with Connect to Network Game using the app's address and port 5556, and type /start. The first to connect can change settings. Turns are autosaved, and after a restart they can /load the latest save. The address is IPv6-only, so players need IPv6 on their network.
